verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلطُّورِ
verses.translation: By the mountain,

verses.text_uthmani: وَكِتَـٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
verses.translation: by a Scripture inscribed

verses.text_uthmani: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ
verses.translation: in unrolled parch-ment,

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
verses.translation: by the much-visited House,

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
verses.translation: by the raised canopy,

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
verses.translation: by the ocean ever filled,

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.translation: [Prophet], your Lord’s punishment is coming––

verses.text_uthmani: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ
verses.translation: it cannot be put off––

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا
verses.translation: on the Day when the sky sways back and forth

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
verses.translation: and the mountains float away.

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to those who deny the Truth,

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.translation: who amuse themselves with idle chatter:

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
verses.translation: on that Day they will be thrust into the Fire of Hell.

verses.text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translation: ‘This is the Fire you used to deny.

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.translation: So is this sorcery? Do you still not see it?

verses.text_uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translation: Burn in it––it makes no difference whether you bear it patiently or not–– you are only being repaid for what you have done.’

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
verses.translation: Those who were mindful of God are in Gardens and in bliss,

verses.text_uthmani: فَـٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: rejoicing in their Lord’s gifts: He has saved them from the torment of the Blaze,

verses.text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translation: ‘Eat and drink with healthy enjoyment as a reward for what you have done.’

verses.text_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
verses.translation: They are comfortably seated on couches arranged in rows; We pair them with beautiful-eyed maidens;

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَـٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
verses.translation: We unite the believers with their offspring who followed them in faith–– We do not deny them any of the rewards for their deeds: each person is in pledge for his own deeds––

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمْدَدْنَـٰهُم بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.translation: We provide them with any fruit or meat they desire.

verses.text_uthmani: يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
verses.translation: They pass around a cup which does not lead to any idle talk or sin.

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
verses.translation: Devoted youths like hidden pearls wait on them.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.translation: They turn to one another and say,

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
verses.translation: ‘When we were still with our families [on earth] we used to live in fear––

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.translation: God has been gracious to us and saved us from the torment of intense heat-

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translation: We used to pray to Him: He is the Good, the Merciful One.’

verses.text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
verses.translation: So [Prophet] remind [people]. By the grace of your Lord [Prophet], you are neither oracle nor madman.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
verses.translation: If they say, ‘He is only a poet: we shall await his fate,’

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
verses.translation: say, ‘Wait if you wish; I too am waiting’-

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verses.translation: does their reason really tell them to do this, or are they simply insolent people?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translation: If they say, ‘He has made it up himself’- they certainly do not believe-

verses.text_uthmani: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.translation: let them produce one like it, if what they say is true.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ
verses.translation: Were they created without any agent? Were they the creators?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.translation: Did they create the heavens and the earth? No! They do not have faith.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
verses.translation: Do they possess your Lord’s treasures or have control over them?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translation: Do they have a ladder to climb, in order to eavesdrop [on Heaven’s secrets]? Let their eavesdropper produce clear proof.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَـٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verses.translation: Does God have daughters while you have sons?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.translation: Do you [Prophet] demand a payment from them that would burden them with debt?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.translation: Do they have [access to] the unseen? Could they write it down?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
verses.translation: Do they think they can ensnare you? It is the disbelievers who have been ensnared.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.translation: Do they really have another god besides God? God is far above anything they set alongside Him.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
verses.translation: Even if they saw a piece of heaven falling down on them, they would say, ‘Just a heap of clouds,’

verses.text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
verses.translation: so leave them, Prophet, until they face the Day when they will be thunderstruck,

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.translation: the Day when their snares will be of no use to them, when they will get no help.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translation: Another punishment awaits the evildoers, though most of them do not realize it.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.translation: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: you are under Our watchful eye. Celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.translation: Glorify Him at night and at the fading of the stars.
